notes: THE DEFAULT POSITION IS FIXED. A panel with no remembered position now opens flush against the top-right corner of the main monitor — verified at x=1928 with a zero-pixel gap, holding through the content fit and across a relaunch.

The 120px gap had two causes stacked, and one of them was mine. The on-screen clamp added earlier today measured against a NORMALISED size whose width is floored at 240px — a sensible minimum for a full panel and wrong for a 120px widget…
The second was the panel remembering an old position that no longer made sense and that position outranking the default, so the corner placement never ran at all.

An edge the panel sits against is now the edge it is ALIGNED to: a resize moves the opposite edge, so a panel snapped right grows leftwards, snapped left grows rightwards, and the same applies top and bottom. Every resize used to re-centre…
